how_to_choose: No GPU: start with qpp-cpu for small circuits. With a GPU: nvidia is the default state vector simulator; add option='mgpu' to scale across GPUs and nodes. Shallow circuits with many qubits: tensornet. Low-entanglement approximation: tensornet-mps. Noise modeling: trajectory noise on nvidia or tensornet, density-matrix-cpu for exact small systems, stim for Clifford/QEC circuits. Time evolution and pulse-level physics: dynamics. Real hardware: pick the provider target and set credentials; braket, scaleway, and qbraid reach multiple providers through one cloud account.

targets.name: qpp-cpu
targets.summary: OpenMP-parallelized CPU state vector simulator based on the Q++ library. The default target on machines without an NVIDIA GPU.
targets.when_to_use: Development and small tests without a GPU; practical up to roughly 25 qubits.

targets.name: nvidia
targets.summary: GPU-accelerated state vector simulator on NVIDIA cuQuantum cuStateVec. The default target when a GPU is available. Options extend it: fp64 for double precision, mgpu for multi-GPU multi-node scaling, mqpu to simulate multiple virtual QPUs in parallel for asynchronous workloads.
targets.when_to_use: The general-purpose choice for exact simulation on GPUs; scale beyond one GPU's memory with option='mgpu', and parallelize independent circuits with option='mqpu'.

targets.name: tensornet
targets.summary: Exact tensor network contraction simulator on cuQuantum cuTensorNet, scaling to multiple GPUs and nodes.
targets.when_to_use: Shallow-depth circuits with large qubit counts where state vector memory is prohibitive.

targets.name: tensornet-mps
targets.summary: Approximate matrix product state simulator built on cuTensorNet, with configurable bond dimension.
targets.when_to_use: Larger circuits with limited entanglement where an approximate result is acceptable.

targets.name: fermioniq
targets.summary: Fermioniq's Ava tensor network emulator, accessed as a cloud service with Fermioniq credentials.
targets.when_to_use: Tensor network emulation as a managed cloud service rather than on local GPUs.

targets.name: density-matrix-cpu
targets.summary: CPU density matrix simulator for exact noisy simulation with cudaq noise models.
targets.when_to_use: Exact noise modeling on small systems; density matrices square the memory cost, so qubit counts stay low.

targets.name: stim
targets.summary: Clifford/stabilizer circuit simulator built on the Stim library.
targets.when_to_use: Clifford-only circuits at very large qubit counts, especially quantum error correction studies.

targets.name: orca-photonics
targets.summary: Simulator for ORCA-style photonic boson sampling computations.
targets.when_to_use: Developing photonic time-bin interferometer programs before running on ORCA hardware.

targets.name: dynamics
targets.summary: GPU-accelerated simulation of quantum dynamics: time evolution of qubits and qudits under Hamiltonians, including open systems.
targets.when_to_use: Pulse-level and Hamiltonian-level physics with cudaq.evolve rather than gate-level circuit sampling.

targets.name: ionq
targets.summary: IonQ trapped-ion quantum computers through the IonQ cloud, with an emulation option for pre-flight checks.
targets.when_to_use: Running on IonQ hardware; requires an IonQ API key.

targets.name: quantinuum
targets.summary: Quantinuum H-series trapped-ion systems, including syntax checkers and emulators before hardware submission.
targets.when_to_use: Running on Quantinuum hardware; requires Quantinuum credentials.

targets.name: anyon
targets.summary: Anyon Technologies/Anyon Computing superconducting systems.
targets.when_to_use: Running on Anyon hardware; requires provider credentials.

targets.name: iqm
targets.summary: IQM superconducting quantum computers.
targets.when_to_use: Running on IQM hardware; requires IQM credentials.

targets.name: oqc
targets.summary: Oxford Quantum Circuits superconducting systems.
targets.when_to_use: Running on OQC hardware; requires OQC credentials.

targets.name: qci
targets.summary: Quantum Circuits, Inc. superconducting systems (Seeker).
targets.when_to_use: Running on Quantum Circuits hardware; requires QCI credentials.

targets.name: tii
targets.summary: Technology Innovation Institute superconducting systems.
targets.when_to_use: Running on TII hardware; requires provider credentials.

targets.name: infleqtion
targets.summary: Infleqtion neutral-atom quantum computers through Superstaq.
targets.when_to_use: Running on Infleqtion hardware; requires Superstaq credentials.

targets.name: pasqal
targets.summary: Pasqal neutral-atom systems for analog quantum computing.
targets.when_to_use: Analog neutral-atom programs on Pasqal hardware; requires Pasqal credentials.

targets.name: quera
targets.summary: QuEra Computing neutral-atom systems.
targets.when_to_use: Analog neutral-atom programs on QuEra hardware.

targets.name: orca
targets.summary: ORCA Computing PT Series photonic systems for time-bin boson sampling.
targets.when_to_use: Running photonic programs on ORCA hardware.

targets.name: quantum_machines
targets.summary: Executes CUDA-Q programs on hardware driven by Quantum Machines OPX control systems.
targets.when_to_use: Labs running QPUs on Quantum Machines controllers.

targets.name: braket
targets.summary: Amazon Braket: reaches multiple hardware providers and managed simulators through an AWS account.
targets.when_to_use: One AWS account for several hardware providers and Braket's managed simulators.

targets.name: scaleway
targets.summary: Scaleway Quantum as a Service: GPU-accelerated simulation sessions and quantum hardware through Scaleway's cloud.
targets.when_to_use: Renting large GPU simulation capacity or reaching hardware through a Scaleway account.

targets.name: qbraid
targets.summary: qBraid cloud platform access to quantum hardware and simulators.
targets.when_to_use: Reaching multiple devices through a qBraid account.
